# Irving & Lavendar Lewis

- [Irving](../character/irving.md) — Romantically involved with — [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — courting and taking walks in the woods together · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P4](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0004), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>
- [Irving](../character/irving.md) — presumed Spouse of — [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — since v2  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000), [v3 ch.Change P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002), [v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) on a wintry evening, and over tea and candy, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) recounts her long-ago romance and quarrel with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduces Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two immediately form a fond friendship during their visit.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for Miss Lavendar's wedding to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). After a joyful ceremony and farewell send-off, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a quiet, romantic moment together outside the stone house as a new chapter of life begins.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0039)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant summer in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) filled with visits from friends like [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), though she misses [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and deals with questions about their altered relationship. During a stay at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on growing up and admits to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) that she refused Gilbert's desire for something beyond friendship.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People
